data.narrative:
Asylon Robotics is a Series B-stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The cap table reflects $40M in total raised to date. The peer universe consists of 8 private companies operating in drones and autonomous systems, including Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, and Joby Aviation; no public comparables exist in the immediate sector.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement. Using the $40M total raised as a proxy baseline, this yields an implied valuation of $76M. A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within narrow filters (only one same-stage peer identified across the Drones & Autonomous universe), making a sector-wide median unreliable without risking material distortion.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $65M (low) to $87M (high), with a midpoint of $76M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single triangulation method; robustness is limited by sparse peer data at this stage and sector. Key uncertainties include the scarcity of mature Series B comparables in autonomous systems, and the heterogeneity of business models (hardware, software, delivery, mobility) within the existing peer set. Additional revenue or unit economics data would significantly improve conviction in the valuation band.
